---
title: "Class results"
---

<div class="phase-banner" id="phase">Live class results. This page updates on its own as responses come in.</div>
<div id="out"></div>

<script>
(async function () {
  const { rpc, store, el, bars, watchSession, DIRECTIONS } = Lab;
  const cards = await (await fetch("js/cards.json")).json();
  const out = document.getElementById("out");
  const DIR_COLORS = { positive: "#2a7f62", negative: "#b23a48", mixed: "#e08a1e", null: "#7a7a7a", inconclusive: "#b8b8b8" };
  const DIR_TEXT = { positive: "Improved", negative: "Worsened", mixed: "Mixed", null: "No effect", inconclusive: "Can't tell" };

  function section(title, sub) { return el("section", { class: "results-section" }, el("h2", {}, title), sub ? el("p", { class: "meta" }, sub) : ""); }

  function definitions(r) {
    if (!r.definitions.length) return null;
    const s = section("1. What counts as education technology?", `${r.definitions.length} definitions submitted`);
    s.append(el("ol", { class: "defs" }, ...r.definitions.map(d => el("li", {}, d))));
    return s;
  }

  function ratings(r) {
    const rows = r.ratings.filter(x => x.phase === "pre");
    if (!rows.length) return null;
    const s = section("2. How the class rated the studies", "Credibility from 1 (not credible) to 5 (highly credible), with the direction each reader took from the study.");
    const stats = cards.map(c => {
      const sub = rows.filter(x => x.study_id === c.id); const n = sub.reduce((a, x) => a + x.n, 0);
      if (!n) return null;
      const mean = sub.reduce((a, x) => a + x.credibility * x.n, 0) / n;
      const dir = {}; sub.forEach(x => { const k = x.direction || "inconclusive"; dir[k] = (dir[k] || 0) + x.n; });
      const cred = {}; sub.forEach(x => { cred[x.credibility] = (cred[x.credibility] || 0) + x.n; });
      return { c, n, mean, dir, cred };
    }).filter(Boolean);
    // Overview: one row per study, sorted by mean credibility
    const ov = el("div", { class: "overview" });
    [...stats].sort((a, b) => b.mean - a.mean).forEach(st => {
      const row = el("div", { class: "ov-row" });
      row.append(el("div", { class: "ov-label" }, el("strong", {}, `Source ${st.c.label}`), el("span", { class: "meta" }, ` ${st.c.public_title}`)));
      const credBar = el("div", { class: "ov-bar" }, el("div", { class: "track" }, el("div", { class: "ov-fill", style: `width:${(100 * st.mean / 5).toFixed(0)}%` })), el("span", { class: "ov-n" }, `${st.mean.toFixed(1)} (n=${st.n})`));
      const stack = el("div", { class: "stack" }, ...DIRECTIONS.filter(d => st.dir[d]).map(d => el("div", { class: "seg", title: `${DIR_TEXT[d]}: ${st.dir[d]}`, style: `width:${(100 * st.dir[d] / st.n).toFixed(1)}%;background:${DIR_COLORS[d]}` }, st.dir[d] / st.n >= .18 ? DIR_TEXT[d] : "")));
      row.append(credBar, stack); ov.append(row);
    });
    const legend = el("div", { class: "legend" }, ...DIRECTIONS.map(d => el("span", {}, el("i", { style: `background:${DIR_COLORS[d]}` }), DIR_TEXT[d])));
    s.append(el("h3", {}, "Mean credibility, highest first"), ov, el("div", { class: "meta" }, "Upper bar: mean credibility out of 5. Lower bar: what readers said the study found."), legend);
    // Detail: credibility distribution per study
    const grid = el("div", { class: "results-grid" });
    stats.forEach(st => {
      const box = el("div", { class: "card" }, el("h4", {}, `Source ${st.c.label}`), el("div", { class: "meta" }, st.c.public_title),
        el("strong", {}, `n=${st.n}, mean credibility ${st.mean.toFixed(2)}`));
      const d1 = el("div"), d2 = el("div");
      box.append(el("div", { class: "meta" }, "Direction of findings"), d1, el("div", { class: "meta" }, "Credibility"), d2);
      bars(d1, st.dir, DIRECTIONS, "pre"); bars(d2, st.cred, [5,4,3,2,1], "pre");
      grid.append(box);
    });
    const det = el("details", {}, el("summary", {}, "Direction and credibility for each study"), grid);
    s.append(det);
    return s;
  }

  function standards(r) {
    const st = r.standards;
    if (!st.length) return null;
    const total = st.reduce((a, x) => a + x.votes, 0);
    const ranked = [...st].sort((a, b) => b.votes - a.votes || a.id - b.id);
    const isFinal = ["final", "closed"].includes(r.phase);
    const winners = isFinal ? ranked.filter(x => x.votes > 0).slice(0, 5) : [];
    const s = section("3. Evidence standards", total ? `${total} votes cast, up to five per person` : "Proposed standards, voting not yet open");
    const list = el("ol", { class: "standards-tally" });
    const max = Math.max(1, ...st.map(x => x.votes));
    ranked.forEach(x => {
      const win = winners.includes(x);
      list.append(el("li", { class: win ? "winner" : "" },
        el("div", { class: "st-text" }, win ? el("span", { class: "check" }, "✓ ") : "", x.text),
        el("div", { class: "ov-bar" }, el("div", { class: "track" }, el("div", { class: "ov-fill", style: `width:${(100 * x.votes / max).toFixed(0)}%` })), el("span", { class: "ov-n" }, `${x.votes} vote${x.votes === 1 ? "" : "s"}`))));
    });
    s.append(list);
    if (winners.length) { const w = el("div", { class: "card winners" }, el("h3", {}, "Our five standards"), el("ol", { class: "big-list" }, ...winners.map(x => el("li", {}, x.text)))); s.prepend(w); }
    return s;
  }

  let phase = null, lastSig = "";
  async function render() {
    const code = store.get().join_code; if (!code) return;
    let r; try { r = await rpc("get_results", { p_join_code: code }); } catch { return; }
    if (!r) return;
    r.phase = phase;
    const sig = JSON.stringify(r); if (sig === lastSig) return; lastSig = sig;
    out.replaceChildren();
    const parts = [definitions(r), ratings(r), standards(r)].filter(Boolean);
    if (!parts.length) out.append(el("p", { class: "meta" }, "Nothing to show yet."));
    out.append(...parts);
  }
  watchSession(sess => { phase = sess.phase; lastSig = ""; render(); });
  setInterval(render, window.EDTECH_CONFIG.pollMs);
  if (!store.get().join_code) { const code = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("code"); if (code) { store.set({ join_code: code.toUpperCase() }); location.reload(); } }
})();
</script>
